in_marathi.name: Sanjidhi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanjidhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sanjidhi is a Sanskrit name meaning 'Goddess of Prosperity'. This beautiful name is derived from the words 'san' meaning 'all' and 'jidhi' meaning 'wishes'. It is believed that the name Sanjidhi bestows upon the child all the wishes and desires they may have, leading to a life filled with joy, prosperity, and good fortune.
